claims.value: GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking is a vision-language model designed to enhance reasoning capabilities. It achieves state-of-the-art performance among 10B-parameter VLMs, matching or surpassing 72B models on 18 benchmarks. It supports bilingual Chinese and English usage.
claims.evidence: Based on the GLM-4-9B-0414 foundation model... designed to explore the upper limits of reasoning in vision-language models... Provides an open-source version supporting both Chinese and English bilingual usage.
pipeline_tag: image-text-to-text ... Vision-Language Models ... Handles arbitrary aspect ratios and up to 4K image resolution.
By introducing a "thinking paradigm" ... The first reasoning-focused model in the series ... incorporating the Chain-of-Thought reasoning paradigm
